scope: Read-only triage of the integrated-48 installed baseline failures. No product/source/fixture/report edits. No live rerun (raw samples unchanged).

baseline.note: 187 is the assertion-mismatch count, not a defect count.
baseline.source_identity_note: RCC source identity is NOT inferred from the installed binary; source_identity.sha 88715b2f is the repo HEAD only.

summary.headline: 36 failed != 36 operator bugs. 5 are strict-oracle wire-representation deltas (meaning preserved), 6 are fixture/oracle/harness defects (no product meaning loss), 25 are real product observations.
summary.dominant_real_defect: Outbound projection to the gemini target (and the gemini entry path) and anthropic->openai_chat is not wired in the installed build.
summary.no_golden_edits: No expected/fixture/helper was edited. Any accepted change must retain the raw red baseline and independently test the counterexample.

groups.title: Provider-wire textshape deltas that are protocol-valid alternative representations

findings.protocol_note: Anthropic Messages content accepts a bare string OR a one-text-block array; both denote the same single text block.
findings.oracle_note: Assertion messages.0.content == "hello" is over-strict; content is present and correctly typed.

findings.provider_body_delta: system: expected system.0.text == "be brief"; actual system == "be brief" (bare string)
findings.protocol_note: Anthropic Messages system accepts a bare string OR a text-block array.

findings.provider_body_delta: System handling: expected top-level instructions == "be brief" plus input.0.role == "user"; actual keeps system as input[0] role=system and omits instructions; max_tokens is mapped to max_output_tokens.
findings.protocol_note: Responses API accepts a system/developer input message OR a top-level instructions field; both are semantically equivalent. max_tokens->max_output_tokens is a correct field mapping.

findings.provider_body_delta: The native image data URI is preserved exactly (image url matched). The only mismatch is the final user message index, because the oracle assumed a different merge of the assistant-text and tool_result turns.
findings.protocol_note: Native image bytes, MIME and data URI are preserved; no description substitution.

findings.provider_body_delta: tools[0] is exec_command (declared first), so expected tools.0/tools.1 names are off-by-one; actual tools = [exec_command, collaboration__spawn_agent, collaboration__freeform].
findings.protocol_note: All three declared tools are present and namespace-prefixed; only the assertion indices are wrong.

groups.title: Assertion/harness defects that do not prove product meaning loss

findings.defect: assertClientResult counts the placeholder observation {kind:'unknown',ok:false,error:'empty_body'} as a parsed observation, producing 'expected closed transport but received a parsed observation'.
findings.product_actual: Provider reached (mock.unavailable-model -> wireModel unavailable-model), returned 429; RCC logged result=terminal_default_floor_exhausted and closed the client connection (status null, closed=true, ECONNRESET, 0 bytes). This is the required behavior.
findings.owner_correction: harness assertions.mjs: treat an observation with ok===false (empty_body) as absent when transport===closed.

findings.defect: Case asserts provider_attempt_count=2 but declares no runtime_setup for a second candidate. RCC policy is same_candidate_retries=0 and the direct pin builds a one-target pool.
findings.product_actual: 1 attempt; provider stream cut (fault=stream_cut_before_content); RCC logged terminal_default_floor_exhausted; client aborted with no provider error leaked.
findings.owner_correction: Add a runtime_setup declaring an alternative provider/auth identity for the second attempt, or lower the asserted attempt count to 1. Do not weaken silently. Already flagged in docs/reports/magpie-live-matrix-corpus-inventory.md 'Current gaps'.

findings.defect: deriveResponsesSemantic dedups output items only by id; streamed function_call items carry only call_id, so one logical call yields 3 output_items. The echo consumer then sees calls.length=3 and fails 'echo consumer requires exactly one observed call'.
findings.product_actual: Turn 1 assertions PASSED; the client emitted exactly one function_call (output_item.added + function_call_arguments.done + output_item.done for output_index 0, call_echo_1).
findings.owner_correction: protocol-semantics.mjs ensureResponsesOutputItem: dedup by call_id/item_id as well as id (or dedup in tool-consumer.mjs extractToolCalls).

findings.defect: The upstream script has no response.output_text.delta; deriveResponsesSemantic only sets top-level text from that event, so text resolves to undefined even though the client relayed the text in response.output_item.done content. The fixture also asserts chat key finish_reason on an anthropic-entry stream.
findings.product_actual: Client SSE body contained the message text.
findings.owner_correction: Extend deriveResponsesSemantic to hoist text from output_item.done/completed item content, or add a response.output_text.delta event to the script; fix the fixture to assert the anthropic text key.

findings.defect: Same missing text extraction as above; the fixture also asserts finish_reason, which the responses semantic model does not produce (it produces status).
findings.product_actual: Client SSE body contained the message text.
findings.owner_correction: Same as responses-to-anthropic-sse; fix the fixture terminal key to the responses status.

findings.defect: Fixture asserts usage.prompt_tokens=7, but the client request has no stream_options.include_usage and the sibling passing chat-to-chat-sse does not emit usage either.
findings.product_actual: Client chat SSE stream carried text "ok" and finish_reason "stop"; no usage chunk. All other assertions passed.
findings.owner_correction: Drop the usage assertion, or set stream_options.include_usage=true on the client request if usage forwarding is required.

diagnostics: provider auth missing or empty for gemini carrier

findings.observed: Provider body chat-shaped (messages, not contents); path used :generateContent while the fixture binds :streamGenerateContent (unbound endpoint); auth missing gemini carrier.
diagnostics: provider path /v1beta/models/gemini-model:generateContent not in expected paths [/v1beta/models/gemini-model:streamGenerateContent]
provider auth missing or empty for gemini carrier

findings.observed: Provider body chat-shaped (messages); auth missing gemini carrier. Client output is gemini-shaped JSON (candidates/finishReason/usageMetadata) although the fixture expects responses-shaped output.0.content.0.text.
diagnostics: provider auth missing or empty for gemini carrier

findings.observed: No provider business attempt (biz=0); RCC logged event=failed status=502 subcode=network_error; client got 200 text/event-stream aborted with body ':' only.
No provider business attempt (biz=0). stderr shows a v3-projection-drop for $.max_completion_tokens (target_protocol=gemini) then the client socket hung up. Request never delivered to provider.
No provider business attempt (biz=0); projection drop of $.max_completion_tokens; client 200 text/event-stream aborted with body ':' only.
anthropic->gemini relay; no provider business attempt (biz=0); projection drop of $.max_completion_tokens; client socket hang up.
anthropic->gemini relay; no provider business attempt (biz=0); projection drop of $.max_completion_tokens; client socket hang up.

groups.group_note: Gemini target is not projected to gemini wire (contents/parts) in any of the 8 cases; auth carrier is not gemini-native. Whether gemini-target translation is in scope for this build is a contract question, but the observed behavior is not a faithful relay.

groups.title: Gemini entry endpoint not registered (HTTP 404 path_not_found, no provider attempt)

findings.observed: RCC logged event=failed status=404 subcode=path_not_found node=V3Error06ClientProjected message='HTTP path is not registered' for /v1beta/models/<model>:generateContent (and :streamGenerateContent). Provider attempt count 0. Client got socket hang up.
findings.diagnostic_note: Logs also show request_id prefix 'openai-chat-router-unknown', which suggests the gemini inbound path is unregistered in this server/endpoint config rather than the client sending a malformed path. Mechanism is not confirmed; do not assert a stage root cause.

groups.group_note: The corpus inventory already flags the streaming gemini endpoint as a coverage gap; the JSON variant fails the same way, so the gap is broader than streaming.

groups.title: anthropic -> openai_chat outbound projection rejects unmapped fields (request never delivered)

findings.observed: RCC logged event=failed status=598 error=V3E3 subcode=provider_request_payload_invalid node=V3Error06ClientProjected message='provider compat profile compat:passthrough failed at request_protocol: UnmappedOutboundFields target_protocol=openai_chat paths=$.request.anthropic_request'. Provider attempt count 0. Client socket hang up.
findings.note: The relay failed to project the anthropic request into openai_chat, then closed the client connection (no provider error surfaced). Contrast the SSE variant (anthropic-to-chat-sse) which DID reach the provider.

groups.title: responses -> responses direct path: no provider attempt, client gets nothing

findings.observed: Provider attempt count 0; provider-captures empty; client status null, socket hang up. stderr contains only the generic 'front socket closed for exec replacement' line; no typed RCC error event.
Provider attempt count 0; client 200 text/event-stream aborted with body ':' only; no typed RCC error event.

groups.group_note: A direct same-protocol responses path producing zero provider attempts is unexpected. Mechanism not determined; recorded as an unresolved product observation.

groups.title: Client SSE relay delivers an empty/keepalive-only stream after a successful provider attempt

findings.observed: Provider reached (path /v1/messages, stream=true) and returned a scripted anthropic SSE stream, but the client got status 200 text/event-stream with body ':' only (aborted, complete=false). No text delivered.
chat->anthropic SSE; provider reached; client got 200 text/event-stream body ':' only (aborted). No text/usage delivered.

groups.group_note: Both share the client-side keepalive-only signature after a successful provider attempt. The upstream provider stream completed normally in chat-to-anthropic-sse; the loss is on the client-facing SSE emission/relay. Mechanism not confirmed. Note anthropic-to-chat-sse PASSED, so the chat-target SSE relay works in at least one direction.

groups.title: responses upstream -> anthropic client SSE keeps the frame skeleton but drops the text delta

findings.observed: Upstream responses SSE carried response.output_text.delta "ok". The anthropic client stream contained message_start with content:[], message_delta (stop_reason=end_turn) and message_stop, but NO content_block_delta, so the assistant text never reached the client. stop_reason and usage were preserved.
findings.note: Contrast with the PASSING anthropic-to-anthropic-sse and anthropic-to-responses-json. The text is genuinely absent from the client bytes, so this is a real meaning loss, not an oracle over-strictness.

groups.title: Responses client output item is a flattened output_text part instead of a message item (chat upstream)

findings.observed: Client body output[0] = {"type":"output_text","text":"ok"} (plus top-level output_text) instead of the Responses message item {"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"ok"}]}. Assertion output.0.content.0.text is missing.
findings.note: The sibling responses-to-anthropic-json PASSES with the canonical message shape, so the chat-upstream path emits a non-canonical Responses output item. Candidate defect; confirm against the Responses output-item schema.

verified_passing_families.note: Unregistered request field excluded from provider wire with continuation; representable response field retained. Correct per requirement routecodex-protocol-compatibility-normalization.
Direct/relay same-protocol and several relay cells pass, which anchors the passing semantic model.
